name: Quiet morning → afternoon break of the morning range
why: On days with no morning move the large orders (pension rebalancing, market-on-close programs) have not executed yet; when they start in the afternoon, the break of the morning range is that flow, and it runs into the close.

scan.when: abs(at(11,30) - open) <= q*atr && (cl(5,1) > lag(5, hi_since(9,30)) || cl(5,1) < lag(5, lo_since(9,30)))
